name: My Best Friend's Birthday
source:
You woke up from bed and checked the time.
Today's schedule is... BFF's Birthday!
It's the birthday of your best friend today!
Prepare something nice, like a cupcake and some flowers!

[From [url=https://lenicon.itch.io/mbfbday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从床上醒来，看了看时间。
今天的日程是… BFF的生日！
今天是你最好的朋友的生日！
准备一些好东西，比如纸杯蛋糕和一些鲜花！

[来自[url=https://lenicon.itch.io/mbfbday]Itch.io[/url]]
